title: The Onyx Club and the first Famous Door
summary: He describes Joe Helbock's walk-up Onyx Club on 52nd Street where the Spirits played, and the Famous Door built next to it.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yes. And Leo the scat singer... Who was the...
It always escapes... That's what I said!
We'll put that in later. We can look that up in the book anyway.
So anyhow, then actually... The first Famous Door was where the Onyx Club used to be before Joe moved it from down there.
Joe Helbach(?), who was the owner.

Helbach/Helbock(?). He was a bartender. It was a private house, and you had to walk up... It was right past where Jimmy Ryan's was. It was a walk-up, and you went... It was a private house, and you went in... This is where Spirits of Rhythm were playing all the time.

Now, next to it, they built the Famous Door. It was a door in white. It looked like the entry to a Southern plantation -- the Famous Door. And the guy that was the host was Ran(?) somebody-or-the-other -- I forget his name. But eventually, they moved, and he went with them when they moved to California.
